deploy-bot: deploybot started rollout: release=2026.03.20-rc3 env=prod target=canary · job=deploy-canary · see: https://deploy.redwood.internal/2026.03.20-rc3

mike: Heads up — one of the prod canary pods is failing health checks. Logs show KMS decrypt errors. @sophia can you take a look? :eyes:

sophia: I pulled the logs — decrypt error: `KMS: alias not found` from the app when it tries to load keystore. Staging doesn't show this, staging uses `kms_alias=redwood/keystore/v2` and prod appears to still point at `redwood/keystore`

ben: That matches the last infra PR I saw. PR #482 added `kms_alias = \"redwood/keystore/v2\"` but the prod terraform workspace never applied it — suspect drift. quick diff:```
- variable "kms_alias" { default = "redwood/keystore" }
+ variable "kms_alias" { default = "redwood/keystore/v2" }
```

ciara: Confirmed — terraform state for `prod` is missing the new var. We applied the alias to `staging` as a hotfix last week via `terraform workspace=staging apply` but forgot to backfill prod. I can prepare a plan, but this is infra-change in prod and needs a change window.

mike: Let's hold the canary rollout. Recommend pinning the canary image back to the last-good tag while we fix prod keystore. Steps I propose:
1) kubectl -n prod set image deploy/my-app my-app=release-2026.03.10 --record
2) mark release as held in deploybot
We avoid a full rollback and keep prod stable.

deploy-bot: deploybot: hold placed on release=2026.03.20-rc3 by mike — reason: kms alias parity failure · action: canary pinned to `release-2026.03.10` · more: reaction :no_entry:

jen: I can backfill the `kms_alias` var and run `terraform apply` in prod, but we have a change window at 02:00 UTC. Need approvals for that slot. @mike @sophia please ack so I can schedule.

sophia: Ack for 02:00 UTC. After apply I'll re-deploy canary and run smoke tests (health + decrypt + sample inferences).

mike: Action items: jen — apply kms_alias to prod in 02:00 UTC window; ben — open doc PR describing keystore migration + postmortem; ciara — add automation to detect workspace drift for kms_alias; I pinned the canary in deploybot already.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary image pinned (release-2026.03.10) · release status: held · thread closed for now — reopen when prod apply succeeded or further action required :white_check_mark:
